verdict: Spend collapsed to $3.85 in the latest day from a $13.63 daily average, signaling a stalled PCOS/Postpartum campaign.
diagnosis: This period burned $2,330 on Facebook leads with no conversion or lead-volume data tracked, making cost per lead impossible to judge against industry norms.

signals.headline: Daily spend dropped to $3.85
signals.detail: Latest day spend is 72% below the $13.63 period average. The campaign is effectively paused or budget-throttled.

signals.headline: $2,330 spent, zero leads reported
signals.detail: No lead, conversion, or pipeline data is flowing in. You cannot prove this campaign is working or failing.

signals.headline: Only 1 active campaign running
signals.detail: All budget sits in one persona campaign. No creative or audience diversification to compare against.

signals.headline: 346,446 impressions this period
signals.detail: Reach is healthy for the spend. The gap is downstream: tracking, follow-up, or offer strength.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Premium and boutique fitness studios average $32 to $52 per Facebook lead in 2026. General fitness runs $18 to $35. Without lead counts, you cannot place Vous Physique on this scale.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Q3 peak fading, January rush ahead
seasonal.body: Third-quarter gym visits rose 1.3% year over year, with boutique studios leading at +1.9%. Lead costs typically climb sharply in January as New Year demand floods the auction.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: Xponential Fitness revenue fell 21% last quarter and same-store sales dropped 7.5%. Independent boutique studios are gaining share, especially with under-35 and women's health niches.

recommendations.title: Fix lead tracking before spending another dollar
recommendations.detail: Confirm the Facebook lead form, pixel, and CRM are capturing leads end-to-end. Without lead counts, cost per lead is a guess and optimization is impossible.

recommendations.title: Investigate why daily spend dropped to $3.85
recommendations.detail: Check for budget caps, payment issues, or ad disapprovals. A campaign spending 28% of its usual daily rate is not actively competing in the auction.

recommendations.title: Test a second creative angle for the persona
recommendations.detail: PCOS and postpartum are distinct audiences. Consider splitting them into two ad sets with tailored messaging to compare lead cost and quality.
